Agrizero.Description: Agrizero je zemědělská biotechnologická firma zaměřená na výzkum a nasazení zemědělské technologie mimo svět. Cílem společnosti je poskytnout síť soběstačných, samostatných 'biologických továren', které nakonec nakrmí předpokládaný 1 milion lidí ve vesmíru. Společnost, vycházející z ekologických katastrof z konce 21. století, má kořeny v čínských iniciativách umělého zemědělství, které šetří svět, a nyní se rozšířila do zařízení v pásu asteroidů, kde díky dodávce ledových asteroidů je vertikální zemědělství a kontrolované prostředí extrémně slibné. Zatímco mnoho z jejich zařízení je stále ve výstavbě, Agrizero je již jedním z hlavních dodavatelů mimosvětových skupin jako ODA, Sinotai a ExMin prostřednictvím neustále se rozvíjející sítě obchodníků.

AppliancePlantGeneticAnalyzer.Description: The Genetic Analyzer can be used to process samples from the Plant Sampler. Once processed, the genetic information of the sampled plant can be viewed by clicking on the search button. Individual Gene Value Widgets: Most gene values will appear as a sliding bar between a minimum value on the left and a maximum value on the right. The actual value of the gene is in the middle of the bar, in orange. Multiple Gene Value Widgets: For temperature and pressure ranges, four genes appear on the same widget. The orange values underneath the bar are the minimum and maximum thresholds for growth. Outside of this range, the plant will stop growing and eventually die. The blue values underneath the bar are the minimum and maximum thresholds for ideal growth. Inside of this range, the plant will grow at maximum speed. The white values above the bar are the minimum and maximum achievable values for the growth threshold.

AppliancePlantGeneticSplicer.Description: The Genetic Splicer can be used to copy a single gene from one 'source' plant to another 'target' plant of the same type. After copying, the source plant will be destroyed. To begin splicing, place a plant or seed bag in the left slot (source) and place another plant or seed bag of the same type in the right slot (target). You can select a gene using the arrow buttons. Close the sliding door and press the green activate button. Once splicing has begun, the device will be locked until the process has finished (which will take approximately twenty minutes). If you want to cancel splicing you can power off the bench or detach the appliance as a last resort.

Asura.Description:
Společnost Asura Biomedia byla založena počátkem 22. století bilionářem Ashanem Gurwajou z Bombaje. Společnost, která se zaměřuje na ‘biotechnologii’, měla vždy ‘elastickou’ představu o tom, co přesně to znamená: vše od farmaceutik po krmivo pro domácí zvířata.
Zázemí společnosti Gurwaja v bioinženýrských firmách staví společnost od samého začátku na nejvyšší úroveň v biologickém průmyslu a rostla přesně tak, jak to její zakladatel zamýšlel: rychle a spolehlivě, strukturovaná speciálně tak, aby pohltila všechny menší firmy.
Téměř v polovině století se ambice společnosti Asura vyvinuly tak, aby zahrnovaly celé zdravotní systémy - nyní je největším poskytovatelem zdravotní péče na Zemi a integruje nemocnice a primární péči se zdravotnickým materiálem, farmaceutickou výrobou a maloobchodem, domácí péčí a pohřebními službami.
Do roku 2150 bylo podnikání Asury jednoduchým návrhem, jak je zachycen v jejich slavném - ne-li neslavném - reklamním sloganu: 'Jsme ve vás'.
Asura.Title: Asura Biomedia

AutomatedRocketPage.Description: Rocket parts are printed on the Rocket Manufactory. Fuselage (Type A1) must be built upon a Launch Mount. A Pumped Gas Engine must be placed in an Engine Mount (Type A1). Resource Umbilicals are placed on the Launch Tower and connect between Umbilical (Gas) and Umbilical Socket (Gas) placed inside the rocket. A Počítač with the Rocket Control Motherboard provides a user interface to control the rocket. A Pair of datalinks are used to create a planet-side Logic Uplink and a rocket-side Logic Rocket Downlink which must be hooked up to the Počítač. An Rocket Avionics should be placed in the rocket to act as the main rocket controller. On the Rocket Control Motherboard Map Screen you can set the rocket destination. Igniting the rocket without a destination set allows you to see rocket performance and fuel usage without launching the rocket. Expect to use 5-20Kmol of fuel per rocket trip, depending on rocket size. A Rocket Scanner is used to chart unknown locations and discover minable asteroids. More complex rockets may use Rocket Miner and Cargo Storage (Small).

CHAC.Description: Společnost, která byla založena v roce 2085 za účelem výroby zbraní pro vesmírné síly Sinotai, je známá výrobou vysoce spolehlivých a cenově dostupných zbraní pro použití mimo svět. Jejich pragmatický přístup se odráží v jejich zaměření na designy vhodné pro 3D tisk a hromadnou výrobu, stejně jako ve vysokém opětovném použití komponentů napříč modely a třídami zbraní. Výsledkem je, že i když zbraně CHAC nevynikají v žádné konkrétní kategorii a rozhodně nikdy nebyly obviněny z velikosti, netrpí žádnými velkými neúspěchy a fungují dostatečně dobře nejznámějšími opatřeními, aby svým konstruktérům vynesly neformální titul 'zbrojař do sluneční soustavy'.
CHAC.Title: CHAC

CableNetworkPage.Description: When placing cables with Моток кабеля you create cable networks. These contain volatile memory that can be read or written to using a Микропроцессор IC10. This includes a variety of special logic variables such as Channel0 through to Channel7. The networks also have readable memory, which contains a list of all the data devices on the network, and can be used with GET to find the ReferenceId for that device. To find out the current quantity of devices in the stack, use the StackSize variable on the network, as the network adjusts its stack size dynamically based on devices within it. Cable Networks are volatile memory, and will change both their order, contents, and data whenever the network changes - so you may need to constantly poll and update the information. To access this, use extra notation on your device references such as d0:1 to access network 1 off the provided device. To find out the connection number, check the stationpedia page for that device for the number under the connections section.

ConstructionPage.Description: Getting Started Typically you will use kits to initiate construction and then a variety of tools and resources to complete. Pay close attention to how many of your kit are required to construct what you have selected, as some structures require more than one of the stack to be consumed. For some kits you will have multiple options, use the Scroll Wheel to change the current option you are looking to build. Build States Some structures will have multiple build states that require different combinations to complete. Your tooltip will advise you of what combination you need to complete the structure. Sometimes you will need to have two objects, one in each hand, to complete a build state. Some tools will need to be turned on first, which can done by pressing O while it's in your active hand. Tooltips If you look directly at a structure that is incomplete you will get information about what you need to do to complete it. If you have a tool in your hand and its not the right tool, a tooltip will appear telling you what you would need to use to deconstruct it. Pressure When building, it's important to note that pressure is measured as a differential. Most structures have a 200kPa pressure limit: if the difference between inside and outside is greater than that, you've got problems.
ConstructionPage.Title: Construction

DecayPage.Description: Food decays over time into Decayed Food, unless refrigerated in a sutable atmosphere. The exact speed of decay varies individually by: - TEMPERATURE - Refrigeration will slow decay, but many foods will be damaged by exposure to extreme low pressure, as well as extreme heat. The optimum temperature is 0 kelvin (-272 C). - FOOD TYPE - Each food type has its own decay properties. Rajčatová polévka lasts a lot longer than a Rajče, for instance. - PRESSURE - Food decays faster when the pressure drops below 1 atmosphere (101kPa). Decay happens exponentially more quickly as the atmosphere approaches a perfect vacuum. There is no effect from higher pressures. - ATMOSPHERE - Different gases can slow and accelerate the decay process. The process will take account of respective gas ratios in mixed atmospheres in calculating the decay modifier. The following rates apply across all foods: > Kyslík x 1.3 > Dusík x 0.6 > Oxid uhličitý x 0.8 > Těkavé látky x 1 > Znečišťující látka x 3 > Oxid dusičitý x 1.5 > Voda x 2 > Vacuum - see PRESSURE (above).
DecayPage.Text:
Food decays over time into {THING:DecayedFood}, unless refrigerated in a sutable atmosphere. The exact speed of decay varies individually by:

- TEMPERATURE - Refrigeration will slow decay, but many foods will be damaged by exposure to extreme low pressure, as well as extreme heat. The optimum temperature is 0 kelvin (-272 C).

- FOOD TYPE - Each {LINK:OrganicPage;food} type has its own decay properties. {THING:ItemTomatoSoup} lasts a lot longer than a {THING:ItemTomato}, for instance.

- PRESSURE - Food decays faster when the pressure drops below 1 atmosphere (101kPa). Decay happens exponentially more quickly as the atmosphere approaches a perfect vacuum. There is no effect from higher pressures. 

- ATMOSPHERE - Different gases can slow and accelerate the decay process. The process will take account of respective gas ratios in mixed atmospheres in calculating the decay modifier. The following rates apply across all foods:

> {GAS:Oxygen} x 1.3
> {GAS:Nitrogen} x 0.6
> {GAS:CarbonDioxide} x 0.8
> {GAS:Methane} x 1
> {GAS:Pollutant} x 3
> {GAS:NitrousOxide} x 1.5
> {GAS:Water} x 2
> Vacuum - see PRESSURE (above).

DeviceLfoVolume.Description: The low frequency oscillator (or LFO) makes everything sound dark, twisted and crunchy by altering the shape of the waves output by a Logic Step Sequencer. To set up an LFO: 1. Place the LFO unit 2. Set the LFO output to a Passive Speaker 2. Set a sequencers' output to LFO - so the sequencer's signal runs through the LFO to a speaker. 3. Place a Stop Watch or use an existing one, then use a Zapisovač logiky to write it to the LFO. 4. Use another logic writer to write the BPM to the LFO. 5. You are ready. This is the future. You're in space. Make it sound cool. For more info, check out the music page.

EVAPage.Description: Your spacesuit provides you with a portable atmosphere, with adjustable pressure and air conditioning (temperature) settings, as well as an warning system that will alert you should the atmosphere inside the suit become hazardous. It functions in conjunction with a suitable helmet to function properly, as well as suitable gas canisters and filters in the suit's various slots. These will need to be changed regularly, and can also be recharged (or drained) using a Stojan na oblek. There are several suits, including the Skafandr and the more pressure- and temperature-resistant Zpevněný oblek. Your suit various readouts are at the bottom-right of the screen. Pressing the appropriate numeric key (2will bring up a panel showing its slots and settings. These include: - A/C On / Off (i.e. Temperature control on/off) - Filters On / Off - Air On / Off - Pressure Up / Down (with a range of 0kPA to 202kPa, or 0-2 Earth atmospheres) - Temperature Up / Down (with a range of 0°C to 60°C) Suits contains 6-8 slots: - Air tank (x1) - insert a canister or smart canister containing a breathable gas mix, eg Kyslík or Dusík/Kyslík 35/65. - Waste tank (x1) - collects gases removed by the filters - Life support (x1) - holds one battery, which powers your A/C, lights, etc. - Plynový filtr (x3) - requires at least one Filtr (oxid uhličitý) (if human), depending on your breathable gas mix. Note that a Zpevněný oblek has 4 filter slots. - IC - Zpevněný oblek only. Pressure: should be set to 50-100 KPa (0.5 to 1 Earth atmospheres). Humans in-game tolerate up to ~250kPa and can survive up to ~300kPA. Temperature: normally set to 18-21°C, with humans in-game preferring 10-29°C, tolerating 0-39°C and surviving around up to 49°C. In higher temperatures, your A/C will consume more battery power to maintain internal temperature. Filters: the default filter is the Oxid uhličitý filter, which captures the gas generated by humans when breathing out. If you are not using 100% Kyslík in your breathing gas, add additional filters, eg if you mix 25% Kyslík + 75% Dusík, the nitrogen will accumulate in your suit over time and suffocate you, unless you have a nitrogen filter. If you have the correct filters and breathable gas, but are still experiencing problems, use the 'Flush' function on your Space Helmet. Low/critical oxygen warnings will sound as your filters cease to function. If damaged, your suit can be patched by holding duct tape in your hand and using 'activate' button.
EVAPage.Text:
Your spacesuit provides you with a portable atmosphere, with adjustable pressure and air conditioning (temperature) settings, as well as an warning system that will alert you should the atmosphere inside the suit become hazardous. It functions in conjunction with a suitable helmet to function properly, as well as suitable gas canisters and filters in the suit's various slots. These will need to be changed regularly, and can also be recharged (or drained) using a {THING:StructureSuitStorage}.

There are several suits, including the {THING:ItemEvaSuit} and the more pressure- and temperature-resistant {THING:ItemHardSuit}.

Your suit various readouts are at the bottom-right of the screen. Pressing the appropriate numeric key (2will bring up a panel showing its slots and settings. These include:

- A/C On / Off (i.e. Temperature control on/off)
- Filters On / Off
- Air On / Off
- Pressure Up / Down (with a range of 0kPA to 202kPa, or 0-2 Earth atmospheres)
- Temperature Up / Down (with a range of 0°C to 60°C)

Suits contains 6-8 slots:
- Air tank (x1) - insert a canister or smart canister containing a breathable gas mix, eg {GAS:Oxygen} or {GAS:Nitrogen}/{GAS:Oxygen} 35/65.
- Waste tank (x1) - collects gases removed by the filters
- Life support (x1) - holds one battery, which powers your A/C, lights, etc.
- {SLOT:GasFilter} (x3) - requires at least one {THING:ItemGasFilterCarbonDioxide} (if human), depending on your breathable gas mix. Note that a {THING:ItemHardSuit} has 4 filter slots.
- IC - {THING:ItemHardSuit} only.

Pressure: should be set to 50-100 KPa (0.5 to 1 Earth atmospheres). Humans in-game tolerate up to ~250kPa and can survive up to ~300kPA.

Temperature: normally set to 18-21°C, with humans in-game preferring 10-29°C, tolerating 0-39°C and surviving around up to 49°C. In higher temperatures, your A/C will consume more battery power to maintain internal temperature.

Filters: the default filter is the {GAS:CarbonDioxide} filter, which captures the gas generated by humans when breathing out. If you are not using 100% {GAS:Oxygen} in your breathing gas, add additional filters, eg if you mix 25% {GAS:Oxygen} + 75% {GAS:Nitrogen}, the nitrogen will accumulate in your suit over time and suffocate you, unless you have a nitrogen filter. If you have the correct filters and breathable gas, but are still experiencing problems, use the 'Flush' function on your Space Helmet. Low/critical oxygen warnings will sound as your filters cease to function.

If damaged, your suit can be patched by holding duct tape in your hand and using 'activate' button.
EVAPage.Title: EVA Suits

ExMin.Description: Po katastrofě Sisyfos na Marsu v roce 2079 bylo ODA oficiálně zakázáno přesouvání asteroidů. Tato radikální změna přinutila nově vzniklý vesmírný těžební průmysl přehodnotit svoji strategii, ale až do otevření vesmírného výtahu Manaus, byla těžba mimozemských zdrojů efektivně nemožná a znamenala pouze okrajovou ekonomiku. Společnost ExMin byla založena v roce 2095 odvěkým švýcarsko-německým těžebním konglomerátem a konsorciem jiných zájmů, byla po několik desetiletí více nápadem než komerční realitou. Vytvořena s jistotou, že vesmírný výtah nakonec dorazí, byla ExMin jedním z prvních, kdo využil nabízený přístup. Následně se stala jedním z nejmocnějších komerčních subjektů sluneční soustavy. S bezpečným přístupem do vesmíru se ExMin stala ústředním hráčem v toku zdrojů do vnitřního systému. Její konkurencí je hlavně brazilský těžební gigant Recurso, ale společnost nikdy úplně neztratila svůj náskok v mimozemské těžbě. Je synonymem kovů vzácných zemin a průkopnické těžby mimozemských zdrojů, stojící v čele vývoje v celé sluneční soustavě.
ExMin.Title: ExMin

FarmingPage.Description: To survive on alien worlds, the ODA expects all Stationeers to set up viable hydroponic systems, or contact registered local resource traders. SETTING UP When setting up your hydroponic system, you will need seeds. Alternatively, you can plant the food itself. Common Stationeer hydroponic equipment includes: - Přenosná hydroponie - Hydroponická nádoba (sada) - Hydroponická stanice (sada) - Harvie All hydroponics systems require water, sunlight and the correct gas mixture - plants require Oxid uhličitý and produce oxygen (except for Mimozemská houba). PLants will not grow in the wrong atmosphere. If plants do not have enough light, you will need to build a Růstové světlo. Your system will depend on available resources and time, but a well-designed farming system can be almost fully automated given sufficient time and resources. HARVESTING Most plants have several growth stages. The first stages are the plant growing through its lifecycle. During the second-to-last phase, the plant will yield fruit but no seeds. In the final phase, seeds and fruit may be harvested from the plant. After that, unless cleared, the plant will die. FERTILIZER Fertilizer alters plant growth processes, and is created by the Portable Composter and the Advanced Composter using organic matter. Fertilizer's affects depend on its ingredients: - Food increases individual PLANT YIELD by up to 3 items - Decayed Food increases plant GROWTH SPEED up to 3 times - Biomasa increases the NUMBER OF GROWTH CYCLES the fertilizer lasts for to a maximum of 5 The effect of these ingredients depends on their respective proportions in the composter when processing is activated. Fertilizer is produced at a 1:3 ratio of fertilizer to ingredients. When processing, Dusík and Těkavé látky is released, as well a small amount of heat.
FarmingPage.Title: Growing Food

Fertilizer.Description: Fertilizer alters plant growth processes, and is created by the basic composter and the Advanced Composter using organic matter. Fertilizer's affects depend on its ingredients: - Food increases PLANT YIELD up to two times - Decayed Food increases plant GROWTH SPEED up to two times - Biomasa increases the NUMBER OF GROWTH CYCLES the fertilizer lasts for The effect of these ingredients depends on their respective proportions in the composter when processing is activated.
Fertilizer.Title: Fertilizer

GasCarbonDioxide.Description: You breathe it out, plants breath it in. They don't grow without it. You can use items placed in Plynový filtr slots to remove this from the atmosphere. Oxid uhličitý has a moderately high specific heat, meaning it makes a good coolant for devices like the Nástěnný chladič. Voda is better, but usually has more important uses.
GasCarbonDioxide.Title: Oxid uhličitý

GasHelium.Description: Helium is a fully inert gas that will neither freeze or condense into liquid, making it an excellent working gas in atmospherics systems that must avoid phase-change.
GasHelium.Title: Helium

GasHydrazine.Description: Hydrazine is the perfect fuel for space exploration as it requires no oxidiser to combust, only needing heat or a spark. It is more commonly stored in it's liquid form Liquid Hydrazine which is stable at room temperature. It is extremely toxic to all forms of life.
GasHydrazine.Title: Hydrazine

GasHydrogen.Description: Hydrogen Is the most efficient fuel by weight for rocketry. When mixed with Kyslík it will cleanly combust into Steam.
GasHydrogen.Title: Hydrogen

GasLiquidAlcohol.Description: Liquid Alcohol is a relatively safe and versatile volatile liquid at room temperatures. When exposed to a vacuum it will decompose into Těkavé látky to form a small head pressure.
GasLiquidAlcohol.Title: Liquid Alcohol

GasLiquidCarbonDioxide.Description: Oxid uhličitý in its liquid form. It can be created by lowering the temperature of Oxid uhličitý gas below it's boiling point. This can be achieved using a Heat Exchanger (Gas to Gas) or a Klimatizace. Liquid Carbon Dioxide introduced into the atmosphere will quickly evaporate back into Oxid uhličitý.
GasLiquidCarbonDioxide.Title: Liquid Carbon Dioxide

GasLiquidHydrazine.Description: Hydrazine in its liquid form. It is stable at room temperature and makes for an excellent rocket fuel.
GasLiquidHydrazine.Title: Liquid Hydrazine

GasLiquidHydrogen.Description: Hydrogen in its liquid form. It can be created by lowering the temperature of Hydrogen gas below it's boiling point. This can be achieved using a Heat Exchanger (Gas to Gas) or a Klimatizace.
GasLiquidHydrogen.Title: Liquid Hydrogen

GasLiquidMethane.Description: Těkavé látky in its liquid form. It can be created by lowering the temperature of Těkavé látky gas below it's boiling point. This can be achieved using a Heat Exchanger (Gas to Gas) or a Klimatizace.
GasLiquidMethane.Title: Liquid Methane

GasLiquidNitrogen.Description: Dusík in its liquid form. It can be created by lowering the temperature of Dusík gas below it's boiling point. This can be achieved using a Heat Exchanger (Gas to Gas) or a Klimatizace.
GasLiquidNitrogen.Title: Liquid Nitrogen

GasLiquidNitrousOxide.Description: Oxid dusičitý in its liquid form. It can be created by lowering the temperature of Oxid dusičitý gas below it's boiling point. This can be achieved using a Heat Exchanger (Gas to Gas) or a Klimatizace. Liquid Nitrous Oxide introduced into the atmosphere will quickly evaporate back into Oxid dusičitý.
GasLiquidNitrousOxide.Title: Liquid Nitrous Oxide

GasLiquidOxygen.Description: Kyslík in its liquid form. It can be created by lowering the temperature of Kyslík gas below it's boiling point. This can be achieved using a Heat Exchanger (Gas to Gas) or a Klimatizace.
GasLiquidOxygen.Title: Liquid Oxygen

GasLiquidOzone.Description: Ozone in its liquid form.
GasLiquidOzone.Title: Liquid Ozone

GasLiquidPollutant.Description: Znečišťující látka in its liquid form. It can be created by lowering the temperature of Znečišťující látka gas below it's boiling point. This can be achieved using a Heat Exchanger (Gas to Gas) or a Klimatizace. Liquid Pollutant introduced into the atmosphere will quickly evaporate back into Znečišťující látka.
GasLiquidPollutant.Title: Liquid Pollutant

GasLiquidSilanol.Description: Silanol in its liquid form is the premium refrigerant gas for utilising phase change to pump heat. With its extremely high heat capacity it also makes an excellent coolant, able to absorb large quantities of heat energy with minimal temperature fluctuation.
GasLiquidSilanol.Title: Liquid Silanol

GasLiquidSodiumChloride.Description: Liquid Sodium Chloride is unique in that it will remain in liquid form at extremely high temperatures making it an excellent medium for storing heat energy. When exposed to a vacuum it will decompose into Znečišťující látka to form a small head pressure. At room temperature it exists as solid Salt.
GasLiquidSodiumChloride.Title: Liquid Sodium Chloride

GasMethane.Description: Methane is a combustible fuel. It is refined from Led (Těkavý)
GasMethane.Title: Těkavé látky

GasNitrogen.Description: Dusík can be mixed with Kyslík to stabilize its flammability and avoid Kyslík toxicity, and is a resource in its own right, useful for creating, a breathable atmosphere (at roughly 3:1 Dusík and Kyslík). The most efficient source of Dusík is from Ice (Nitrice) deposites found around the Solar System. You can Condense Dusík into Liquid Nitrogen by lowering its temperature below its boiling point.
GasNitrogen.Title: Dusík

GasNitrousOxide.Description: Nitrous oxide is a reactive gas that will knock players out if inhaled. It acts as an oxidizer for combustion, and allows volatile gasses to burn significantly hotter, faster, and at a lower autoignition temperature. It can be produced in an energy intensive process inside of a Nitrolyzer.
GasNitrousOxide.Title: Oxid dusičitý

GasOxygen.Description: Oxygen provides energy when released in combustion, and also bonds with hydrogen to create Voda. It is created by plants, as well as from processing Led (Oxit). It is highly flammable at low temperatures.
GasOxygen.Title: Kyslík

GasOzone.Description: Ozone is a highly energetic oxidiser. As with Oxid dusičitý, when mixed with a volatile gas Ozone will create extra hot combustion.
GasOzone.Title: Ozone

GasPollutant.Description: Also known as 'X', Znečišťující látka is created when smelting certain metals. A concentration of 0.1 mol or greater will cause your suit to warn about poison in the atmosphere. Pollutant has a high specific heat, making it an excellent coolant. Unfortunately it is extremely bad for organic beings, and will severely damage the lungs of most Carbon based organisms.
GasPollutant.Title: Znečišťující látka

GasPollutedWater.Description: Polluted water is a waste product from the use of Voda in certain devices. It will freeze into Pure Ice Polluted Water but boil into Steam. A Water Purifier can be used to convert it back to Voda.

GasSilanol.Description: Silanol is the premium refrigerant gas for utilising phase change to pump heat. It has a wide liquid range an is more commonly found in it's liquid form Liquid Silanol.

GasSteam.Description: Evaporated Voda. It can be created by rasing the temperature of Voda to its boiling point. When introduced into a pipe Steam will condense back into Voda if it's temperature is below it's boiling point. Steam can be created by combusting Těkavé látky and oxygen using the H2 spalovač
GasSteam.Title: Steam

GasWater.Description: You can obtain water by smelting or crushing Led (Voda) using a Pec or an Drtič ledu. Voda is critical for plants to stay alive, and grow food. It is also an exceptional coolant with a very high specific heat capacity. Voda will evaporate into Steam if it's temperature is raised above its boiling point.
GasWater.Title: Voda

GeFabrik.Description:
GeFabrik, který je oficiálně známý jako Gewehrfabrik GmbH, je jednou z nejstarších a nejuznávanějších zbrojních společností na světě, která vyrábí výjimečně přesné a špičkové střelné zbraně.
V návaznosti na kolaps evropského zbrojního průmyslu v letech 2030 vytvořila skupina nezaměstnaných ozbrojených zaměstnanců GeFabrik. Společnost, která se věnuje obnově původních konstrukčních principů, je legendou pro rozsáhlé testování, které někdy trvá až 10 let, aby bylo možné vyrábět formáty zbraní ‘ganz’.
Společnost GeFabrik je všeobecně považována za společnost, která jednou rukou zachránila německou výrobní reputaci, aniž by dělala nic pro svůj smysl pro humor.
GeFabrik.Title: GeFabrik

GeneLowTemperatureResistance.Description: The lower limit of temperature that the plant is able to grow at.
GeneLowTemperatureResistance.Title: Low temperature resistance

GeneLowTemperatureTolerance.Description: The length of time a plant can stay below its low temperature limit before it starts taking damage.
GeneLowTemperatureTolerance.Title: Low temperature tolerance

GeneSuffocationTolerance.Description: The length of time a plant can be starved of its inhaled gas requirements before it starts taking damage.
GeneSuffocationTolerance.Title: Suffocation tolerance

GeneUndesiredGasResistance.Description: The partial pressure threshold of toxic gases that the plant is able to grow in.

GeneticsPage.Description: Plants have a set of Genes that modifies their behavior. A plant's genes will be manipulated in a number of ways, both naturally as well as artificially. When a plant produces fruit or seeds it will pass on its genetics with a small random mutation. On top of random mutations, a plant's condition over its life can also affect its genes - for example if a plant is starved of water, while it may affect the plants growth speed and yield, the offspring will receive genes that make it require less water. In this way you can manipulate your crop's ideal conditions. There are a number of tools you will need to manage your crops effectively: Plant Sampler and Plant Genetic Analyzer. These tools allow you to sample a growing plant and see the state of its genes. Plant genetics is not an exact science and will require trial and error and repeated attempts before you are able to reach your targets.
GeneticsPage.Text:
Plants have a set of Genes that modifies their behavior. A plant's genes will be manipulated in a number of ways, both naturally as well as artificially. When a plant produces fruit or seeds it will pass on its genetics with a small random mutation.

On top of random mutations, a plant's condition over its life can also affect its genes - for example if a plant is starved of water, while it may affect the plants growth speed and yield, the offspring will receive genes that make it require less water. In this way you can manipulate your crop's ideal conditions.

There are a number of tools you will need to manage your crops effectively: {THING:ItemPlantSampler} and {THING:AppliancePlantGeneticAnalyzer}. These tools allow you to sample a growing plant and see the state of its genes.

Plant genetics is not an exact science and will require trial and error and repeated attempts before you are able to reach your targets. {LIST_OF_GENES} {LIST_OF_GENETIC_DEVICES}

Hiiragi.Description:
Společnost Hiiragi, kterou založil Noboru Hiiragi po hospodářské bublině z let 2110, pohltila několik významných mimosvětových aktiv a rychle se stala nejpoužívanější komunikační sítí trans-sluneční soustavy.
Pokud jste v poslední době komunikovali s přáteli a rodinami mimo svět, proběhlo to prostřednictvím sítě Hiiragi, i když byla označena pod jednou z mnoha dětských společností. Hiiragi je také prodejcem číslo jedna pro PCD (osobní komunikační zařízení), stejně jako hluboký, i když obtížně hodnotitelný investor do pozemních telekomunikačních sítí.
Hiiragi.Title: Hiiragi

HydrationPage.Description: Your average Stationeer needs to drink water regularly. However, arcane and possibly misguided ODA health and safety regulations have long denied Stationeers the right to in-suit hydration mechanisms. Instead, they must take regular drink breaks to open their helmet, and imbibe water. Doing so in an unpressurized environment is unadvised. How often to drink? This is determined by your difficulty level, the heat of the planet and how much you like to move your body. Water comes in many forms. At least one Láhev na vodu is supplied to Stationeers as part of their rations when landing on new planets, with more in your lander crates. These can be refilled using a Plnička lahví na vodu, which must itself be connected to a liquid pipe network. The network itself can be filled using a Drtič ledu with a suitable supply of ice. Your thirst rate can be adjusted set on the main settings menu by adjusting your Hunger/Hydration rate slider.
HydrationPage.Text:
Your average Stationeer needs to drink water regularly. However, arcane and possibly misguided {LINK:ODA;ODA} health and safety regulations have long denied Stationeers the right to in-suit hydration mechanisms. Instead, they must take regular drink breaks to open their helmet, and imbibe water. Doing so in an unpressurized environment is unadvised.

How often to drink? This is determined by your difficulty level, the heat of the planet and how much you like to move your body.

Water comes in many forms. At least one {THING:ItemWaterBottle} is supplied to Stationeers as part of their rations when landing on new planets, with more in your lander crates. These can be refilled using a {THING:ItemWaterBottleFiller}, which must itself be connected to a liquid pipe network. The network itself can be filled using a {THING:StructureIceCrusher} with a suitable supply of ice.

Your thirst rate can be adjusted set on the main settings menu by adjusting your Hunger/Hydration rate slider.

ItemNitrice.Description: Nitrice is the nickname given to solid Dusík Ice, and found on many planets and moons in the Solar System. Given the inert nature of the Dusík it produces, the ice is useful when making breathable atmospheres with low flammability. Highly sensitive to temperature, nitrice will begin to melt as soon as it is mined, unless the temperature is below zero, or it is stored in the Hornický opasek, Hornický opasek (pokročilý) or devices like the Drtič ledu or Fridge Small.

ItemPlantEndothermic_Genepool1.Description: Agrizero's Winterspawn atmospheric bio-processor is a recent addition to their catalog of genespliced environmental decorations. Using ambient heat to split Voda into Těkavé látky and Kyslík, the Winterspawn cools its surroundings, when supplied with sufficient Dusík. The alpha variant has a peak cooling and electrolysis capacity of 90Watts and is most efficient operating in air temperatures of 0 to 40 Degrees Celsius.

It is liquid cooled for superb thermal performance and boasts superior resistance to impacts and lava exposure. While the HARM suit is not compatible with a Základní jetpack, Stationeer's are still able to equip a Zpevněný batoh or Hard Mining Backpack. Due to its extra stability and size, storms do not effect movement speed while in a HARM suit; however, this results in an overall reduction to movement in general operation. LogicStepSequencer8.Description: The ODA does not approve of soundtracks or other distractions. As such, Stationeers have had to create their own musical accompaniment to the demanding labor of building and maintaining off-world infrastructure. Central to this pastime is the step sequencer, which allows Stationeers to sequence short musical patterns or loops. DIY MUSIC - GETTING STARTED 1: Connect 8 Device Step Units to your step sequencer via the data port on the left hand side. 2: Label each step unit, then assign step units 1 through 8 on the step sequencer using the screwdriver. 3: Select the output speaker (eg Passive Speaker) where the sequencer will play the sounds. This needs to be connected to the logic network on the right hand side of the sequencer. 4: Place a Stop Watch and use a Čtečka logiky and Zapisovač logiky to write the time to the time variable on the sequencer. 5: Set the BPM on the sequencer using a Číselník and a Zapisovač logiky to write to the sequencer's BPM variable. A higher bpm will play the sequence faster. 6: Insert a sound cartridge of your choosing and select which variant of sound you wish to play by pushing the arrow buttons located above and below the sound cartridge slot. 7: Choose the pitch of the sounds to play by setting the dial on each of your 8 step units to the desired note. With drums, each note is a different drum sounds. You can trial your sounds by pushing the activate button on each step unit (with the sequencer inactive). 8: Get freaky with the Low frequency oscillator. 9: Finally, activate the sequencer, Vibeoneer.
LogicStepSequencer8.Title: Logic Step Sequencer

MusicPage.Description: The ODA does not approve of soundtracks or other distractions. As such, Stationeers have had to create their own musical accompaniment to the demanding labor of building and maintaining off-world infrastructure. Central to this pasttime is the step sequencer, which allows Stationeers to sequence short musical patterns or loops. DIY MUSIC - GETTING STARTED 1: Connect 8 Device Step Units to your step sequencer via the data port on the lefthand side. 2: Label each step unit, then assign step units 1 through 8 on the step sequencer using the screwdiver. 3: Select the output speaker (eg Passive Speaker) where the sequencer will play the sounds. This needs to be connected to the logic network on the righthand side of the sequencer. 4: Place a Stop Watch and use a Čtečka logiky and Zapisovač logiky to write the time to the time variable on the sequencer. 5: Set the BPM on the sequencer using a Číselník and a Zapisovač logiky to write to the sequencer's BPM variable. A higher bpm will play the sequence faster. 6: Insert a sound cartridge of your chosing and select which variant of sound you wish to play by pushing the arrow buttons located above and below the sound cartidge slot. 7: Choose the pitch of the sounds to play by setting the dial on each of your 8 step units to the desired note. With drums, each note is a different drum sounds. You can trial your sounds by pushing the activate button on each step unit (with the sequencer inactive). 8: Get freaky with the Low frequency oscillator. 9: Finally, activate the sequencer, Vibeoneer.
MusicPage.Text:
The {LINK:ODA;ODA} does not approve of soundtracks or other distractions.
As such, {LINK:Stationeers;Stationeers} have had to create their own musical accompaniment to the demanding labor of building and maintaining off-world infrastructure.
Central to this pasttime is the step sequencer, which allows Stationeers to sequence short musical patterns or loops. 

{HEADER:DIY MUSIC - GETTING STARTED}

1: Connect 8 {THING:DeviceStepUnit}s to your step sequencer via the data port on the lefthand side.

2: Label each step unit, then assign step units 1 through 8 on the step sequencer using the screwdiver.

3: Select the output speaker (eg {THING:PassiveSpeaker}) where the sequencer will play the sounds. This needs to be connected to the logic network on the righthand side of the sequencer.

4: Place a {THING:StopWatch} and use a {THING:StructureLogicReader} and {THING:StructureLogicWriter} to write the time to the time variable on the sequencer.

5: Set the BPM on the sequencer using a {THING:StructureLogicDial} and a {THING:StructureLogicWriter} to write to the sequencer's BPM variable. A higher bpm will play the sequence faster. 

6: Insert a sound cartridge of your chosing and select which variant of sound you wish to play by pushing the arrow buttons located above and below the sound cartidge slot.

7: Choose the pitch of the sounds to play by setting the dial on each of your 8 step units to the desired note. With drums, each note is a different drum sounds. You can trial your sounds by pushing the activate button on each step unit (with the sequencer inactive).

8: Get freaky with the {THING:DeviceLfoVolume}.

9: Finally, activate the sequencer, Vibeoneer.
MusicPage.Title: Making Music

Norsec.Description: Díky svým kořenům v obranném průmyslu na počátku 20. století byl Norsec (také znám jako Severní bezpečnostní systémy) jedním z prvních, kdo přijal těžbu asteroidů - jeden z jeho remorkérů byl zapojen do nechvalně proslulého Sisyfova zásahu na rodící se marťanské kolonii v Sanders. Norsec byl oficiálně zbaven jakéhokoli nesprávného jednání, ale když ODA zakázala asteroidové přemístění, společnost přesunula své zaměření na infrastrukturu a výrobu. Orbitálně založená divize vesmírných systémů společnosti Norsec je zodpovědná za design a výrobu hlavních dopravních systémů ODA, přičemž se také říká, že má velký zájem o ExMin. Společnost je také známá svou ochotou zapojit se do experimentální robotické technologie.
Norsec.Title: Norsec

NutritionPage.Description: HUNGER Stationeers get hungry eventually, but not all food is created equal. Also, your hunger rate varies depending on settings and difficulty. Eating will only consume that part of an item adequate to restoring your hunger to 100%. Stationeers receive supplies of food such as Agrizero Cereální tyčinka in their lander upon arriving on a new world. When these are exhausted, you must find new sources of sustenance - such as growing your own, from the seeds supplied, or contacting a Trader. NUTRITION Eating raw ingredients will satisfy hunger less than meals, ie will replace a smaller proportion of your hunger. The basic elements of food are created using hydroponics systems. These can be processed into recipe ingredients using the Zpracovatel činidel, then turned into meals using a Mikrovlnná trouba or Automated Oven. Your hunger rate can be adjusted set in the main settings menu by adjusting the Hunger/Hydration rate slider in the settings. Note that the hunger slider also governs your Thirst.
NutritionPage.Title: Hunger and nutrition

ODA.Description: V důsledku zemské krize se zaměření lidstva na vesmír zmenšilo. Přesto mnozí cítili, že bez ambicí mimo naši domovskou planetu by náš druh mohl slábnout. Offworld Development Agency (Vesmírná rozvojová agentura), vytvořená v roce 2070CE nově sestavenou Organizací spojených národů, dostala velmi specifický cíl - vést a podporovat lidský průzkum prostoru v době, kdy se vesmír vytrácel z mysli veřejnosti. Slavnostně otevřela program Stationeer v roce 2095CE. ODA pochopila, že financování by bylo obtížné, a proto tento program koncipovala jako pomalou vesmírnou iniciativu s nízkými výdaji. Zatímco se někteří vysmívali Stationeerům jako 'kosmickým trosečníkům za nízkou cenu', úspěch programu je důkazem moudrosti a účelnosti vize ODA.
ODA.Title: ODA

OrePage.Description: These are items that are mined and can often be smelted. You can also get mixed ore by recycling items in the Recyklátor and then passing it through the Odstředivka which will break it into ore for smelting. There are some ores that will melt when exposed to sunlight or heat and produce gases. For example Led (Voda) melts into Voda and Kyslík. Be careful to keep these out of heat or sunlight until you actually want them to melt.
OrePage.Text:
These are items that are {LINK:MiningPage;mined} and can often be {LINK:SmeltingPage;smelted}. You can also get mixed ore by recycling items in the {THING:StructureRecycler} and then passing it through the {THING:StructureCentrifuge} which will break it into {LINK:OrePage;ore} for {LINK:SmeltingPage;smelting}. 
There are some ores that will melt when exposed to sunlight or heat and produce {LINK:GasPage;gases}. For example {THING:ItemIce} melts into {GAS:Water} and {GAS:Oxygen}. Be careful to keep these out of heat or sunlight until you actually want them to melt.{LIST_OF_ORES}

Recurso.Description: Na konci 21. století se tato dlouholetá brazilská těžební skupina rozvětvila do vesmíru. Společnost, zaměřená především na nerostné suroviny a kovy, je možná nejlépe chápána jako rozšíření brazilské vlády - jen velmi málo politických osobností vyššího stupně v moderní Brazílii není zapojeno do jedné či druhé části tohoto průmyslového monstra. Zapojení do jihoamerické politiky dalo společnosti silný vliv na vesmírný výtah Manaus. Tato hluboká státní kontrola vedla k tomu, že ostatní skupiny - včetně ODA - uplatňovaly určitou ‘flexibilitu’ vůči společnosti Recurso. Obvinění z nezákonného přemístění asteroidů, porušení bezpečnosti a četná porušení předpisů v oblasti obchodu se toho stěží dotkly. Obránci mezitím poukazují na to, že u soudu bylo prokázáno jen velmi málo, a Recurso je stěží samo - proto je pravdou: 'Ve vesmíru žijeme všichni ve skleněných domech.'

Robot.Description: Designed by - presumably drunk - Norsec roboticists, AIMeE (or Automated Independent Mechanical Entity) can be a Stationeer's best friend, or tiresome nemesis, or both several times in the same day. Intended to unearth and retrieve ores automatically, the unit requires basic programming knowledge to operate, and IC editor. AIMEe has 7 modes: RobotMode.None = 0 = Do nothing RobotMode.None = 1 = Follow nearest player RobotMode.None = 2 = Move to target in straight line RobotMode.None = 3 = Wander around looking for ores in 15 co-ords radius RobotMode.None = 4 = Unload in chute input or chute bin within 3 meters / 1.5 large grids RobotMode.None = 5 = Path(find) to target RobotMode.None = 6 = Automatic assigned state, shows when storage slots are fullPřipojí se k Logický vysílač

SanitationPage.Description: Over time satisfying thirst and hunger of Stationeers will cause them to need to relieve themselves. The ODA recommends that Stationeers set up a Modern Toilet within their base after landing, requiring an atmosphere and Вода to operate. This will output Грязная вода which can be recycled using a Очиститель воды and then used for other purposes, such as farming or drinking. The Waste Bag can be used as a portable alternative to the toilet but the contents are not recoverable.
SanitationPage.Text:
Over time satisfying {LINK:HydrationPage;thirst} and {LINK:HungerPage;hunger} of Stationeers will cause them to need to relieve themselves. The {LINK:ODA;ODA} recommends that Stationeers set up a {THING:StructureToiletModern} within their base after landing, requiring an atmosphere and {GAS:Water} to operate. This will output {GAS:PollutedWater} which can be recycled using a {THING:StructureWaterPurifier} and then used for other purposes, such as {LINK:FarmingPage;farming} or {LINK:HydrationPage;drinking}. The {THING:ItemWasteBagEmpty} can be used as a portable alternative to the toilet but the contents are not recoverable.

Sinotai.Description: Sinotai je jediný 'tradiční' státní subjekt, který přežil mimozemskou politiku, ale jeho dosah a síla je až na druhém místě za samotnou ODA. V mnoha ohledech relikvie - podřízena neuvěřitelně komplikované podnikové byrokracii vázané na Zemi - jejíž struktura umožnila Sinotai dosáhnout neuvěřitelných věcí. Na počátku 21. století dokázala svou sílu tím, že na Mars umístila první lidi, založila první mimozemský gigawattový energetický systém a první vesmírnou rafinérii pohonných hmot, jen málo vesmírných organizací postrádá určitý stupeň vztahu se Sinotai. V častém vtipu se říká, že bez nich není možné ve vesmíru nic udělat. Bez ohledu na pravdu, přístup Sinotai k mimozemskému vývoji zahrnoval metodu 'měkké síly', od memoranda s Recurso (umožňující přednostní přístup k vesmírnému výtahu Manaus) až po pochybná výhodná spojenectví s řadou obchodních skupin.
Sinotai.Title: Sinotai

SmeltingPage.Description: Jakmile budete mít rudy, musíte je přeměnit na ingoty, aby jste mohli použít jejich činidla. Tavením často vznikají plyny. K tomu dochází buď v Oblouková pec (pro jednoduché recepty) a v Pec pro složitější slitiny, a nakonec v Pokročilá pec pro velmi složité Superslitiny. U složitých slitin budete muset dosáhnout směsí v perfektních poměrech, teplota a tlak.
SmeltingPage.Text: Jakmile budete mít {LINK:OrePage;rudy}, musíte je přeměnit na {LINK:IngotPage;ingoty}, aby jste mohli použít jejich {LINK:ReagentPage;činidla}. Tavením často vznikají {LINK:GasPage;plyny}. K tomu dochází buď v {THING:StructureArcFurnace} (pro jednoduché recepty) a v {THING:StructureFurnace} pro složitější {LINK:AlloyPage;slitiny}, a nakonec v {THING:StructureAdvancedFurnace} pro velmi složité {LINK:SuperAlloyPage;Superslitiny}. U složitých slitin budete muset dosáhnout směsí v perfektních poměrech, {LINK:TemperaturePage;teplota} a {LINK:PressurePage;tlak}.
SmeltingPage.Title: Tavení

Stationeers.Description: Na počátku 22. století se Země vynořovala z katastrofy. Její zdroje erodovaly, naše populace se snížila, obnova byla duchem doby. Program Stationeer, který zahájila v roce 2095CE Offworld Development Agency (ODA: Vesmírná rozvojová agentura), byl věnován jedinému ideálu: udržování lidstva namířeného ke hvězdám. Stationeeři jsou všechno: astronauti, inženýři a průzkumníci, nasazeni s omezeným vybavením a nástroji, vyškolení dělat více za méně. Mají za cíl přeměnit prostředí ke svému prospěchu, zajistit infrastrukturu pro lidi ve vesmíru, a to za zlomek nákladů na tradiční vesmírné programy. Stationeeři jsou především naším předvojem ve vesmíru, dokážou vybudovat a udržovat základny kdekoli od Měsíce po Mimas a ještě mnohem dále. Jsou školeni v přežití ve vesmíru, těžební a stavební technice, základní metalurgii, elektronice, raketové technice, hydroponii a v dalších ‘tajemných’ vědách, prostě dělají všechno, co je zapotřebí pro prosperitu a přežití. Jsou také proslulí tím, že nemají žádná vstupní kritéria a že neexistuje nic jako ‘typický’ Stationeer. Psychologické profilování naznačuje, že úspěšní kadeti vykazují ‘základní’ pragmatismus a cílevědomost, ale někteří z nejslavnějších Stationeerů nemají žádnou z těchto vlastností. Program náborů z oblasti stavebnictví, vojenského a leteckého průmyslu, vývoje softwaru, těžebních uskupení, vědeckých oborů a dokonce i náboženských řádů, je - v zásadě - otevřen celému lidstvu.
Stationeers.Title: Stationeers

StructureBattery.Description: Providing large-scale, reliable power storage, the Sinotai 'Dianzi' station battery is the heart of most Stationeer bases. There are a variety of cautions to the design of electrical systems using batteries, and every experienced Stationeer has a story to tell, hence the Stationeer adage: 'Dianzi cooks, but it also frys.' POWER OUTPUT Able to store up to 3600000W of power, there are no practical limits to its throughput, hence it is wise to use Kabelová cívka (silná). Seasoned electrical engineers will also laugh in the face of those who fail to separate out their power generation networks using an Regulátor napěťového okruhu and Transformátor velký.

There are a variety of cautions to the design of electrical systems using batteries, and every experienced Stationeer has a story to tell, hence the Stationeer adage: 'Dianzi cooks, but it also frys.' Seasoned electrical engineers will also laugh in the face of those who fail to separate out their power generation networks using an Regulátor napěťového okruhu and Transformátor velký.

StructureCombustionCentrifuge.Description: The Combustion Centrifuge is a gas fuel powered version of the Odstředivka. If a Recyklátor or unbalanced Pec outputs reagent mixture rather than the desired ingots, a centrifuge allows you to reclaim the raw ore. It also refines Dirty Ore produced from the Deep Miner and Dirty Ore produced from the Rocket Miner. A combustible fuel mix should be supplied to the gas input, and waste gasses should be vented from the output. The machine's RPMs must be controlled via the throttle and combustion limiter levers. If the Combustion Centrifuge gains, or loses, RPMs too fast it will experience stress, and eventually grind to a halt. Higher RPMs directly result in faster processing speeds. The throttle lever controls the amount of fuel being pulled into the machine, increasing the temperature inside the engine, and leading to an increase in RPM. The limiter lever influences the speed of the combustion, and how much uncombusted gas is in the exhaust. Ejecting ore from the Combustion Centrifuge while it is at high RPMs will result in additional stress build up. If turned off while not stressed, the machine will automatically start to brake, and reduce RPMs in a controlled manner.
StructureCombustionCentrifuge.Title: Combustion Centrifuge

StructureFridgeBig.Description: The Xigo Koolaid fridge is a self-cooling storage device with 15 slots that preserves food when powered and turned on. While many users have complained about the placement of the power switch, its place in the pantheon of off-world whiteware is unquestioned. With its own permanent internal atmosphere, the Koolaid fridge slows the decay of food by maintaining an optimal internal temperature. Its power usage varies on the external temperature against which it must balance its internal temperature. As such, it must shed heat to operate, so the Koolaid fridge DOES NOT work in a vacuum. Also, don't leave the door open, as it will equalize with the current world temperature. And maybe start to beep. For more information about food preservation, visit the food decay section of the Stationpedia.
StructureFridgeBig.Title: Fridge (Large)

Harvesting a different plant while the hand slot is full will be possible if the hopper slot is empty. The second liquid pipe connection is an optional heat-exchanger connection which exchanges heat between the pipes contents and the engine bell, the Setting variable drives the effectiveness of the heat-exchanger.

StructureRocketCelestialTracker.Description: The Celestial Tracker can be placed in Rockets and when turned on will provide data that can be used to orientate devices such as the Telescope. The Horizontal and Vertical output is localized to the orientation of the tracker. You can calibrate your alignment by comparing the result for the primary body with the output from the Senzor denního světla. Full functionality will only be available in orbit, but you can configure using the primary body. For aligning with the telescope, have the face plate facing up and the cables facing in the same direction as for the telescope and the output values will be aligned.

StructureStirlingEngine.Description: Harnessing an ancient thermal exploit, the Recurso 'Libra' Stirling Engine generates power via the expansion and contraction of a working gas to drive pistons operating an electrical generator. When high pressure hot gas is supplied into the input pipe, this gas will heat the hot side of the unit, then pass into the output pipe. The cooler side uses the room's ambient atmosphere, which must be kept at a lower temperature and pressure in order to create a differential. Add a working gas by inserting a Kanystr na plyn. The unit must be deactivated when adding or removing canisters, or the working gas may leak into the surrounding atmosphere. Gases with a low molecular mass make the most efficient working gases. Increasing the moles of working gas can result in a greater potential power output. However, overpressuring the unit may have... sub-optimal results.
StructureStirlingEngine.Title: Stirling Engine

Společnost TK, která nyní vyrábí řadu návrhů a komponentů sítí skluzů, má silné mimosvětové zastoupení v důsledku partnerství Afro-Sino v druhém případě 21. století. Společnost sídlí v ‘znovuobjevené’ čtvrti Kigamboni v Dar E Salaamu a pravidelně vstupuje do rozvojových partnerství s CHAC, a díky tomu se řada jejich produktů vyznačuje zřetelnou podobností. TemperatureControlPage.Description: In order to control the temperature of a system, we have to either add heat to it thus increasing its temperature or remove heat from it thus cooling it down, that's the basic idea of temperature control. Devices that achieve this goal for you are Nástěnné topení (sada), Nástěnný chladič (sada), Potrubní radiátor, and Klimatizace. NOTE: There are many methods of temperature control. Some involve none of the devices mentioned. Here, we are covering the basics. It is important to understand your environment before you install any type of temperature control. The gas or liquid volume is an important factor to when choosing your method of temperature control. A Malá nádrž can hold up to 6000L, while a Velká nádrž can hold up to 50,000L, which means that if both are full, the small tank will react faster to temperature changes. A room is a space that can hold a certain amount of gas. The bigger it is the more volume it will be able to hold, so the same rules generally apply to tanks and rooms. PIPE NETWORKS A pipe network is one or more pipe segments connected to each other with no separation at any point. A pipe network shares the same atmosphere everywhere along the pipe, no matter how large it is. If you change the temperature or pressure at one end of the network, the furthest end will experience the same change immediately with no delay. Adding devices to a network may split it into two different networks. For instance, adding a Objemové čerpadlo to a pipe network will split the network into two networks: one before the pump, and one after it. Use the Kapesní tablet with the Atmosférický analyzátor installed to see information about the contents of any pipe network. RADIATORS Manufactured in the pipe bender, a Potrubní radiátor will help you exchange heat between pipes and their surrounding environment. They work on both insulated pipes and pipes, as well as having liquid variants. In normal conditions a pipe segment will exchange heat with its surrounding environment, but adding a radiator to that pipe segment will speed up the process greatly. A pipe segment will keep exchanging heat with the surrounding atmosphere until both equalize in temperature. PASSIVE COOLING You can cool or heat any environment by using a Potrubní radiátor to exchange heat between two atmospheres. An example of this would be to place a pipe on the wall, fill it with gas, and place radiators on the pipe. Now the two atmospheres of the pipe and the room will exchange temperature until their environments equalize. WALL HEATER The Nástěnné topení (sada) is a simple device that can be installed on a wall or a frame and connected to power. When switched on, it will start heating the surrounding environment. It consumes 1010W of power and can be controlled by logic chips to run when the temperature hits a certain level. WALL COOLER The Nástěnný chladič (sada) complements the wall heater, which can only raise the temperature. The wall cooler functions by drawing heat from the surrounding atmosphere and adding that heat into its pipe network. In order to run the wall cooler properly, you will need to connect pipes to the wall cooler and fill the connected pipe network with any type of gas. The gas's heat capacity and volume will determine how fast it reacts to temperature changes. The higher the difference in temperature between the gas stored in the pipes and the room, the less efficient the wall cooler will be. So to keep the wall cooler running at an acceptable efficiency you will need to get rid of the heat that accumulates in the pipes connected to it. A common practice would be to run the pipes to the outside and use radiators on the outside section of the pipes to get rid of the heat. The less efficient the wall cooler, the less power it consumes. It will consume 1010W at max efficiency. The wall cooler can be controlled by logic chips to run when the temperature hits a certain degree. If the wall cooler is flashing an error then it is missing one of the following: - Pipe connection to the wall cooler. - Gas in the connected pipes, or pressure is too low. - Atmosphere in the surrounding environment or pressure is too low. AIR CONDITIONER The Klimatizace in its basic form works just like the wall cooler and can benefit from the same designs. However it is more powerful. It cools faster and uses considerably more power depending on the situation, thus making it more suitable to deal with large volumes and large areas. It can heat or cool depending on the setting. AIR CONDITIONER: HOW IT WORKS The air conditioner has 3 pipe connections (Input, Output, Waste). Gas goes in through the input side, then, depending on the setting, heat is added or removed from the incoming gas, and added to the waste pipe. The output gas will then exit through the output connection, cooler or hotter depending on the setting. You can connect the input pipe to the output pipes (you can see if they are connected if they both have the same network number): this will give you more control over the temperature, since the gas won't reach the target temperature after the first pass. It will take time and energy to remove or add heat from any gas. The way you install and set up your air conditioner depends on what you are trying to cool or heat up. For a room, you will need a passive vent inside the room connected to the air conditioner's input and output, while the waste pipe has to be filled with a coolant gas. The air conditioner does not have to be inside the room. The only part of this setup that has to be in the room is the passive vent which will circle the room's atmosphere through to the air conditioner to be cooled or heated. You can use a single air conditioner to do both heating and cooling. You just need to change the target temperature setting on the panel. However, if you want to automate cooling and heating at the same time you will need one air conditioner for cooling and another one for heating, because the setting on the panel can only be changed manually. Setting up more than one air conditioner on the same pipe network can be useful if you need things to go faster or if you need to use some for heating and others for cooling. Do this by connecting the inputs and the outputs of the air conditioners together and having them all share the same pipe network for their inputs and outputs. The waste pipe network can also be shared between them, but it has to be separate from the input/output pipe network. The same idea applies when using the air conditioner to control the temperature of tanks. However, instead of using a passive vent, you will need to connect the tank to the air conditioner directly. AIR CONDITIONER: KEEP IN MIND - The greater the difference in temperature between the input pipe and the waste pipe, the more power the air conditioner will use - The power consumed by the air conditioner can exceed 5kW, therefore using heavy cables to power up air conditioners is recommended. - Running the waste pipe outside and equalizing it with the outside atmosphere isn't always the best option: the gas you put inside of it can be applied somewhere else in your base. AIR CONDITIONER: BASE TEMPERATURE CONTROL There are many ways to control the temperature of your base using air conditioners - this is one way of achieving this goal: Step 1: Run a single pipe network around your base, and install passive vents connected to this pipe in every room you wish to be controlled by this setup. This is 'Network A' Step 2: Connect 'Network A' to an air conditioner's input and output. Step 3: Connect the waste pipe to a different network, and run it to the outside. Install radiators on this network. This is the basic setup. To automate it you will need a pipe analyzer on Network A, then read the temperature and run your air conditioner(s) accordingly. Good luck, Cadet!

TradingPage.Description: Trading is an essential part of a Stationeers existence, especially on more extreme worlds, where new cadets may be challenged at first to survive without assistance. There are three separate tiers of contacts. These contacts have increasing difficulties to contact, and hang around for about 20 minutes before they leave and another one takes their place, so you’ll have to find the harder contacts if you want to check out many traders. Contacts must be resolved by the dish before it can determine how accurately it is pointed at the contact. The time to resolve is determined by the dish's power output multiplied by the dish alignment, over the contact’s expected resolve wattage. If the contact is resolving too slowly, it likely indicates you are not close to the target at all, and you should try a very different angle. Alternately, the contact might have a very high expected wattage, and your current dish just isnt big enough to resolve it in a reasonable time. The resolving process only uses 10% of the actual power your dish is set to. Once you have resolved the contacts position, you’ll be able to press the interrogate button. Similar to resolving, you’ll need to land enough wattage on the contact. The interrogation dialog will inform you of the current calculations. Interrogation does have a hard minimum, and if the dish is not pointed well enough, or the power is too low, you won't be able to start the process. Interrogation also has a time requirement, with harder contacts taking significantly longer, so you’ll want to use high wattages to ensure you finish before the trader moves on. Once interrogation is complete, you can land the trader just as before.

WeatherPage.Description: The Solar System's planets are not as calm as they may seem. After seven days on any world with an atmosphere, the inscrutable forces of nature swing into action – hitting unwary Stationeers with blizzards, dust storms and volcanic events. As such, the ODA recommends that freshly deployed Stationeers create an airtight base within 7 days of landing. Any dynamic objects left outside in a storm – on Mars, Loulan, Vulcan or Europa – risks being blown far, far away, including your lander. Likewise, be aware that solar panels are fragile and may have their glass shattered, or occasionally even be destroyed by a sufficiently ferocious storm. During storms, their output is also drastically reduced.

Xigo.Description:
Průzkum 2150CE odhalil Xigo 'X' jako jeden z nejuznávanějších symbolů na světě. Přesto jen málo účastníků dokázalo jasně popsat skutečný rozsah společnosti.
Přesně tam, kde společnost začíná a končí, bylo předmětem nekonečných teorií, finančních studií a soudních sporů - původně webové stránky pro srovnání cen, konglomerát se rozšířil o data, distribuci a nakonec výrobu.
Jednalo se o zdánlivě nevybíravou expanzi, která se nezaměřovala na jedno odvětví, ale na všechny - a to v tolika oblastech, že obchodní analytici do značné míry odmítli myšlenku Xigo jako jediného subjektu. Jedná se spíše o koncepční seskupení pro odvětví lidské činnosti. A i když jsou tyto statistiky - ze své podstaty - obtížně potvrditelné, nedávné odhady naznačují, že Xigo zaměstnává více než 1.5% celé lidské rasy.
Stačí říct, že produkuje téměř všechno.
Xigo.Title: Xigo
